versos.texto_bv: Somente Jônatas, filho de Asael, e Jaazias, filho de Ticvá, se opuseram a isso; e Mesulão e o levita Sabetai os apoiaram.
versos.traducao_literal: Somente Jônatas, filho de Asael, e Jaazias, filho de Ticvá, ficaram sobre isto; e Mesulão e Sabetai, o levita, os ajudaram.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0028): O verbo 'se opuseram a isso' interpreta עָמְדוּ עַל־זֹאת como oposição ao plano de Esdras, mas essa é uma leitura contestada, não a única possível. O controle KJV fornecido traduz o mesmo trecho como 'were employed about this matter' (ficaram encarregados deste assunto) — sentido oposto ao de 'opuseram-se'. A tradução literal da BV ('ficaram sobre isto') é neutra e não decide entre as duas leituras. — evidência: termos_originais: עָמְדוּ עַל (Vqp3cp + R) admite tanto 'estar encarregado de/à frente de' quanto 'levantar-se contra', dependendo do contexto; controles.kjv.texto para Ezra.10.15: 'Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them' — não fala em oposição. Como o verso seguinte diz que Mesulão e Sabetai 'os ajudaram' (עֲזָרֻם), a leitura de 'encarregados/apoiados' é pelo menos tão coerente quanto a de 'oposição apoiada'. Corrigir o sentido da BV para se alinhar ao controle mudaria o conteúdo do verso, por isso registro objeção em vez de alterar.

kjv.texto: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

vizinhos.14: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
vizinhos.16: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

web.texto: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

vizinhos.14: Let now our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God be turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”
vizinhos.16: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
